title: The Cans by the Sink
notes: Side quest from the Scene Book's Monday quest log: "A small chore at home. The easiest floor version in the game." The words here are Claude's draft.
Taking the cans out is an action in the kitchen (actions.json). Doing it gives Resolve +1 in tonight's encounter. The cans are also one of the encounter's floor versions.

effects.title: The Cans by the Sink
effects.objective: Two cans by the sink. Ten minutes, maybe less.

text: Two cans by the sink from Saturday. Rinse, crush, out to the bin. Ten minutes, maybe less.
They've been there long enough that you don't see them anymore.
